text:
anya: Quick sync — I opened a PR to consolidate 429 / timeout / context-limit guidance and add SDK snippets. Need reviewers and an agreement on the fallback examples we include. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1129

mike: Link looks good, thanks. What's the scope? full error-ref rewrite or just add examples?

anya: Mostly focused on troubleshooting docs: 429s, client timeouts, trimming context, and example fallback flows (model variant fallback, retry-with-backoff). Not rewriting tone. Also fixing a couple of dead internal links the linter flagged.

docs-bot: :robot_face: docs-lint report: 2 broken links found (docs/old-runbooks/ -> 404, /sdk/python/old-snippet -> 404). PR 1129 includes tentative fixes but please verify before merge.

samir: I can add SDK snippets. Which languages are highest priority? py + ts? Any preferred style (sync vs async)?

evie: Both py and ts and show async usage. Also include a minimal cross-language example for "context trim then retry" pattern. Keep snippets <20 lines.

kevin: Suggest we add a short migration checklist for customers who used the old 429 guidance. Call out behavior changes (retry headers, new backoff defaults) and Dedicated/Private notes. I can draft that.

anya: Perfect. Samir: can you paste a quick python snippet for the retry+trim flow so we can review?

samir: Sure — quick draft:

```python
# example: trim context and retry on 429 with exponential backoff
from time import sleep
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")

for attempt in range(4):
    try:
        resp = client.generate(prompt=current_prompt, timeout=3.0)
        break
    except RedwoodClient.TooManyRequestsError:
        if attempt == 3:
            raise
        # trim oldest messages from context
        current_prompt = trim_context(current_prompt, keep_tokens=1024)
        sleep(0.5 * (2 ** attempt))

# handle resp...
```

samir: JS version coming up too.

mike: Nice — maybe use the SDK's built-in retry helpers? We added a `with_retries()` helper in the client recently. If we show manual code, also mention the helper as recommended.

samir: Good call, here's a compact JS snippet showing the helper:

```javascript
// compact: use withRetries + trim helper
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });

await client.withRetries({ maxAttempts: 4 }, async (ctx) => {
  try {
    return await client.generate({ prompt: trimPrompt(ctx.prompt, 1024), timeout: 3000 });
  } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === 'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS') throw err;
  }
});
```

evie: These are great. For the docs text, call out common failure modes: short client timeout vs server 429 vs long-tail queueing. Also add a small table mapping symptom -> likely cause -> suggested immediate mitigation (e.g., increase timeout, enable fallback model, trim context, use retry header).

anya: I drafted that table in the PR but it needs wording edits. @kevin — when you do the migration checklist, can you include an item to mention the retry header we surface on responses (X-Redwood-Retry-After)? That helps customers do smarter client backoff.

kevin: Will do. Also I'll add a note for Dedicated customers: if you pin to a heavy model, fallback policies won't trigger unless you opt into automatic variant routing. We should surface how to configure that in Console (link to UI doc).

mike: One more asks: please add a tiny runnable example for context trimming that uses token-count helpers from the SDK. People copy-paste.

samir: Adding that now.

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: Link check re-run: previously broken link docs/old-runbooks/ -> fixed in PR 1129. Remaining: /sdk/python/old-snippet -> 404 (line 78).

anya: Good — who can own replacing that python snippet link? I don't want the merge blocked.

samir: I can update that reference to the new snippet path in this PR.

deploy-bot: :calendar: Reminder: docs freeze window tomorrow 03:00 UTC for site build. If this needs staging review, please request a preview before 01:00 UTC.

evie: We should probably land the snippet changes before freeze. I can do a final proofread tonight.

kevin: I'll draft the migration checklist and add the Console config link. Ping me in the PR when samir pushes the updated snippet path.

anya: Sounds good. Final list: samir — add py/ts snippets + update broken link; kevin — migration checklist + Console note; evie — final copy edit; mike — quick API/feature review on with_retries helper; me — triage docs-bot issues and submit for preview.

mike: :thumbsup: I'll check the helper API and leave inline comments.

samir: pushed snippet updates and the token-count helper example. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1129/files

docs-bot: :robot_face: CI preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-1129 — please sanity-check snippets and table rendering.

evie: Preview looks clean. A couple phrasing nits in the remediation table, will push small edits.

anya: Awesome. If there are no blocking concerns, let's aim to merge before freeze. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
